scripts.build: npm run build:clean && npm run build:lib && npm run build:vike && npm run build:server && npm run build:alias
scripts.build:clean: rimraf app/dist packages/core/dist packages/agent/dist packages/mcp/dist packages/engine/dist packages/worker/dist
scripts.build:mcp: npm run build -w @qiln/core && npm run build -w @qiln/agent && npm run build -w @qiln/mcp
scripts.build:lib: npm run build:mcp && npm run build -w @qiln/engine && npm run build -w @qiln/worker
scripts.server:dev:agent:watch: node scripts/wait-for.js packages/core/dist/client.d.ts && npm run dev --workspace=@qiln/agent
scripts.server:dev:mcp:watch: node scripts/wait-for.js packages/agent/dist/index.d.ts && npm run dev --workspace=@qiln/mcp
scripts.server:dev:engine:watch: node scripts/wait-for.js packages/core/dist/sentinel.js && npm run dev --workspace=@qiln/engine
scripts.server:dev:worker:watch: node scripts/wait-for.js packages/core/dist/sentinel.js && npm run dev --workspace=@qiln/worker
scripts.server:dev:wait:types: node scripts/wait-for.js packages/core/dist/client.d.ts packages/core/dist/server.d.ts packages/engine/dist/client.d.ts packages/engine/dist/server.d.ts packages/worker/dist/server.d.ts
scripts.server:dev:compile: npm run server:dev:wait:types && node scripts/wait-for.js packages/core/dist/.build-complete packages/engine/dist/.build-complete packages/worker/dist/.build-complete && nodemon --verbose --watch app/types --watch app/server --watch app/server/tsconfig.json --ext ts,json --ignore app/dist/server --ignore app/dist/client --exec "tsc --project ./app/server/tsconfig.json --incremental && tsc-alias -p ./app/server/tsconfig.json && node --import ./register.mjs app/dist/server/index.js"
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:server && npm run build:alias && node --import ./register.mjs app/dist/server/db/seed.js
scripts.db:reset: npm run build:server && npm run build:alias && node --import ./register.mjs app/dist/server/db/reset.js
scripts.db:rebuild: npm run db:reset && rimraf app/server/db/migrations && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.type:verify: npm run build && npm run type:check
scripts.type:check:packages: npm run type:check -w @qiln/core && npm run type:check -w @qiln/agent && npm run type:check -w @qiln/mcp && npm run type:check -w @qiln/engine && npm run type:check -w @qiln/worker
scripts.type:check: npm run type:check:packages && npm run type:check:app
